item: Row 454: feed back-off advances on consecutive failures; an only-failed feed is unread to the language balance
summary: A FetchError now advances the capped de-churn back-off (300 s doubling to 6 h) instead of resetting it; kill-switch refusals and crawl-delay deferrals move nothing; the first read (200/304) resets it. equilibrium_filter treats a feed whose checks only failed as never read. Coverage counts a backed-off failing feed as failed, keeping the de-churn label true. No strings changed.
